description:
Rightis is a public registry of identity rights. People and rights holders
register their face, voice and persona, and set which AI uses they allow,
which need their approval, and which they refuse.

This plugin lets ChatGPT check that registry before generating a likeness,
a voice or a persona of a real person. Ask about someone by name or by their
Rights ID and you get back what they allow, what needs approval, and whether
they have refused use of their data for AI training.

It is read-only and needs no account or key. It never returns photos,
recordings or contact details. Someone who is not registered is unconfirmed,
which is not the same as cleared for use.

defaultPrompt: May I use Lee Min-woo's likeness as AI training data?
